02 · Privacy first

Your data must stay private

The fastest way to adopt AI is uploading your data to someone else's cloud — and also the riskiest. Every document you upload can end up training a third party's model, exposed in a breach, or simply out of your control.

Since your data never leaves your perimeter, there's no third-party transfer to audit — it fits GDPR natively, instead of depending on someone else's privacy policy.

Privacy and confidentiality

Your knowledge and your clients', out of your control.

Vendor dependence

You rented your intelligence; you don't own it.

Loss of your edge

If your data lives in someone else's cloud, so does your competitive moat.

06 · Frequently asked

Before you ask

Is this expensive to implement?

You're already paying the real cost: every hour an employee spends searching for information by hand. We start with one bounded case and measure the hours saved, so you compare the savings against the investment, not the other way around.

Do I need my own technical team?

No. We handle implementation and maintenance; your team just uses it, like any other tool.

How long until it's working?

Depends on the case, but the first test with your own documents is usually up and running in weeks, not months.

Do I need powerful, expensive servers?

Depends on your document volume and number of concurrent users. A pilot with a few hundred documents and a handful of users runs on modest hardware, no GPU — we size the exact hardware for your case before starting.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes — since your data never leaves your perimeter, there's no third-party transfer to audit, so it fits natively instead of depending on another provider's privacy policy.

What happens to my data if I stop working with you?

It runs on your own infrastructure from day one — it's yours, and doesn't depend on you remaining a customer.
